newsitem.title: USA: U.S. cash soymeal - Soymeal sales slow, basis down.
newsitem.headline: U.S. cash soymeal - Soymeal sales slow, basis down.

text.p: Sales of soymeal in U.S. cash markets were slow Tuesday following the three-day Memorial Day holiday weekend, and some basis offers dropped in response, dealers said.
"With Monday being a holiday, we're just trying to work out logistics this morning," said one dealer in the southeast. "Nobody is doing much of anything."
Some said falling soymeal prices on the Chicago Board of Trade were likely to trigger light end-user buying if the market stays lower the rest of the day or falls further this week.
"We're probably going to have some people in doing flat price business if we stay down," a dealer said. "Others are just going to wait and see if we go lower."
At 1034 CDT, July soymeal futures were down $1.20 at $279.00 per ton and August was down $1.90 at $261.70.
